info.name: AI Agent Workflows
info.description:
Test collection for the AI Agent Workflows build.

BEFORE YOU RUN ANYTHING: open the Variables tab and fill in every value. The q-prefixed ones are the rawRequest key names Jotform generated for your form, which you read off your first real test submission. They are not predictable.

WHAT THIS CAN AND CANNOT PROVE: Scenario 1 has no Webhook response module, so Make answers 'Accepted' whether the token filter passed or stopped the run. Every Scenario 1 request here asserts delivery only; its real verdict is read in Airtable and in Make's execution history, and each request's description says what to look for. Scenario 2 does have response modules, so those requests assert status codes, CORS headers and bodies properly.

Runs cost credits. The 18 payloads plus the extras are roughly 300 credits on a 1,000 credit month, so do not use Postman's Collection Runner on the whole thing casually.

item.name: 0 · Site and function
item.description: Checks the Vercel deployment, the Turnstile verification function and the approval proxy. Only T6 reaches Make.

request.description: Expect 400 and error 'missing_token'. If you get 500 and 'not_configured', TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is not set, or you set it and did not redeploy.

item.name: T2 verify-turnstile with the wrong method

request.description: Expect 405 and an Allow: POST header.

item.name: T4 approve proxy with a malformed payload

request.description: Expect 400 and error 'bad_request', with NOTHING forwarded to Make. Check Make's history afterwards: there should be no new execution. This is the credit saving half of the proxy, rejecting junk before it reaches a webhook where even a filtered run costs a credit.

item.name: T5 approve proxy with the wrong method

request.description: Expect 405 and an Allow: POST header.

The whole path the browser now takes. Expect 200 and status ok, with Make's own response passed straight through. Uses decision=reject so no email is sent. If you get 500 and 'not_configured', MAKE_APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL is not set in Vercel, or it was set without a redeploy.

exec: // No CORS assertion here on purpose: this is a same origin request,
// so there is no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header and none needed.

item.name: T3 verify-turnstile with a dummy token

request.description: The result depends on which secret key is deployed. With Cloudflare's test secret 1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA, expect success true. With your production secret, expect success false, because production secrets reject dummy tokens. Both are correct answers, so read the one you expect.

exec: pm.test('200 with a boolean verdict', function () {
'| test secret -> true, production secret -> false');
